Past Election Results
Past election results are grouped by election date. For additional county and statewide data, visit the
North Carolina State Board of Elections.
Use this chart to view the physical location of early voting sites listed in the canvass documents as site codes.
Early Voting Site Codes
2026
03/03/2026 - Primary Election
Due to the county's complex jurisdictional boundaries, certain contests apply to a small number of eligible voters. When turnout is low, it is possible to identify the ballot selections of specific voters. To comply with N.C.G.S. § 163-165.1(e), which states: “Voted ballots and paper and electronic records of individual voted ballots shall not be disclosed to members of the public in such a way as to disclose how a particular voter voted, unless a court orders otherwise” the Wake County Board of Elections has taken measures to maintain ballot secrecy by combining necessary reported votes.
